newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Four killed in Austrian helicopter crash.
newsitem.headline: Four killed in Austrian helicopter crash.

text.p: An Interior Ministry helicopter crashed in northern Austria in the early hours of Saturday, killing all four people on board, the ministry said. The cause of the crash was not immediately known.
The helicopter, just one year in operation, was on a routine flight checking Austria's northern borders. The four men on board were all Austrians and employees of the Interior Ministry.
